change_summary: Material NOAA NGOFS2 guidance shift with no Jubilee confirmation. The new 09Z cycle strengthens near-term modeled shoreward transport to +47 m over 1 hour and +147 m over 3 hours, versus +1 m and +68 m in the prior 03Z cycle. Six-hour guidance remains shoreward but eases from +182 m to +146 m, while 12-hour guidance becomes more seaward (-140 m versus -30 m). The matching antecedent nowcast changed to seaward over 1 and 3 hours (-44 m and -94 m) and shoreward over 6 hours (+57 m). This is MODEL guidance only, not observed current or oxygen. The 08:08:12 CDT capture identity matches status, burst and vision across all six owner cameras with 3/3 frames; all are healthy, but pcl_e2_back_deck has low detectability and remains UNKNOWN for biological conclusions. The other five views showed no Jubilee signal in their visible areas. Grand Hotel initially stalled for 30 seconds, then recovered after one reload and advanced across a 30.580-second daylight sample; Fairhope advanced across 30.551 seconds after Seek to live and reported currently playing live at the end. Neither showed event behavior, and neither Fairhope beach is visible. The NWS forecast remains east winds 5-10 kt with waves 1 ft or less/light chop. No defensibly dated September 9 first-person Jubilee report was found.
